description: This file declares classes and functions related to Multicast DNS (mDNS) client operations, including transaction handling, listener management, socket creation, and network endpoint configuration within the net namespace.

classes.name: MDnsTransaction
classes.description: Represents a one-time mDNS record lookup transaction with callback handling and result types.

classes.name: MDnsListener
classes.description: Listens for updates on specific mDNS records, with delegate callbacks for record changes.

classes.name: MDnsSocketFactory
classes.description: Creates and manages sockets for mDNS communication.

classes.name: MDnsClient
classes.description: Manages mDNS operations including creating listeners and transactions, and network listening control.

methods.name: CreateListener
methods.description: Creates an mDNS listener for a specific record type and name.

methods.name: CreateTransaction
methods.description: Creates an mDNS transaction for querying records of a specific type and name.

methods.name: StartListening
methods.description: Begins listening for mDNS messages using the provided socket factory.

methods.name: IsListening
methods.description: Checks if the client is currently listening for mDNS messages.
